title: Summing through the last element
description: You can follow a recursive sum with a one-element stopping case.

steps.description: sumlist checks whether the rest of L is empty. You return the first element when L contains just that one value.
For a longer list, you add its first element to the sum of the rest. Each recursive call receives a shorter list.

steps.question: Which value supplies the stopping case for (list 1 2 3)?
steps.answer: The final one-element list contains 3, so that call returns 3 directly.

steps.description: The pending additions combine 2 with 3 and then 1 with that result. You see 6 in the output.
